title: Income Tax Amendment (Labour Mobility Program) Bill 2022
short_title: Income Tax Amendment (Labour Mobility Program) Bill 2022

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would impose the withholding tax supporting revised tax arrangements for foreign resident workers taking part in specified Australian labour mobility programs.
It would set the tax rate for covered employment payments, working with companion amendments that define the programs, payment categories and administration of the tax.
The bill would accompany the Treasury tax integrity and business investment bill, with its imposition provisions commencing the day after royal assent.
changes: The withholding tax would be set at 15 per cent of amounts subject to it.
With companion amendments, the tax would cover eligible Pacific Australia Labour Mobility scheme income paid from 1 March 2022.
The combined measures would also cover Australian Agriculture Worker Program payments from 1 March 2022 until 30 June 2022.
summary.affected: Foreign resident workers in covered labour mobility programs would be affected.
